projectsContent: These are the projects and contributions that best reflect the direction of my work: practical systems, open-source collaboration, Rust, and a deep interest in the Ethereum ecosystem. I care about building software that is useful, understandable, and resilient, and I am always open to thoughtful ideas from people who share that curiosity.
portfolioDescription: My personal website, built to present my projects, research interests, experience, and writing in one place.
ethrexDescription: LambdaClass's Rust implementation of an Ethereum execution client.
